description: This Java class is a Spring configuration that defines a batch job for updating savings accounts to dormant status. It sets up a job with a specific step that executes a tasklet, utilizing Spring Batch features like JobBuilder, StepBuilder, and transaction management.

classes.name: UpdateSavingsDormantAccountsConfig
classes.description: Spring configuration class that defines beans for a batch job and a step related to updating savings accounts to dormant status.

methods.name: updateSavingsDormantAccountsStep
methods.description: Creates and returns a Step object that executes the UpdateSavingsDormantAccountsTasklet as part of the batch job.

methods.name: updateSavingsDormantAccountsJob
methods.description: Creates and returns a Job object that runs the update savings dormant accounts process, with a RunIdIncrementer for job instance uniqueness.
